title: Software engineering: read six core action terms
description: Read high-frequency Japanese software engineering words for fixes, implementation, environment setup, and team sharing.

review.provenance: Independently authored short engineering-workplace cues and explanations; common word spellings and meanings are linguistic facts.
review.rightsBasis: Original agent-written prompts, translations, contexts and explanations; no copied text, audio or third-party assets.

reviewItems.skill: Read 修正 (fix/revision) in bug and PR updates
Read 実装 (implementation) in feature work
Read 環境 (environment) in bug reproduction and deployment
Read 設定 (configuration/setting) in setup tasks
Read 相談 (consultation/discussion) when escalating blockers
Read 共有 (sharing) in team handovers

exercises.prompt: In a pull request or bug ticket, read this word for a code fix or revision and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Push a fix for a failing test or review comment.

text.context: Push a fix for a failing test or review comment.

exercises.explanation: 修正 is read しゅうせい and means a fix, correction, or revision in code or documents.

exercises.prompt: In a sprint task about building a feature, read this engineering term and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Finish the implementation of an API endpoint.

text.context: Finish the implementation of an API endpoint.

exercises.explanation: 実装 is read じっそう and means software implementation; small っ doubles the s sound before そう.

exercises.prompt: When describing whether a bug happens in test or production, read this word and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Check the test environment before reproducing an issue.

text.context: Check the test environment before reproducing an issue.

exercises.explanation: 環境 is read かんきょう and means environment (such as テスト環境, test environment, or 本番環境, production environment).

exercises.prompt: When checking configuration files or app preferences, read this word and type its reading in hiragana.
exercises.explanation: 設定 is read せってい and means setting or configuration; small っ doubles the t sound.

exercises.prompt: When you hit a blocker and want to ask a senior engineer or lead for advice, read this word and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Ask a teammate for a quick consultation about a blocker.

text.context: Ask a teammate for a quick consultation about a blocker.

exercises.explanation: 相談 is read そうだん and means consultation or discussing an issue to decide the next step.

exercises.prompt: When posting logs, links, or status notes to the team channel, read this word and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Share status notes and logs with the team.

text.context: Share status notes and logs with the team.

exercises.explanation: 共有 is read きょうゆう and means sharing information, documents, or status across a team.
